acceptance.text: Unit tests for inheritance (multi-level, override, reset) and persistence (round trip, atomic write, `.bak`) are green
acceptance.evidence: 2026-11-15, Windows: `cargo test -p fernjo-core` 69 passed. Inheritance (`resolve::tests`: nearest_folder_wins_over_three_levels, local_value_wins_even_if_equal_to_inherited, inherits_username_from_grandparent, defaults; `tree::tests`: patch_inherit_clears_local_value, resolve_node_uses_folders_above). Persistence (`persist::tests`: save_then_load_round_trips_nested_tree_with_settings, save_leaves_no_temp_file, second_save_keeps_previous_content_as_bak, corrupt_main_falls_back_to_bak, newer_schema_is_refused_and_files_untouched, both_unreadable_is_unreadable_error_and_writes_nothing; `store::tests`: failed_save_rolls_back_memory, mutation_is_persisted_and_survives_reopen).

acceptance.text: Manual: nested folders and connections created, moved by drag and drop, state preserved after restart
acceptance.evidence: 2026-11-15, Windows 11, in the real app (`pnpm tauri dev` and the release build), driven through the WebView's DevTools protocol: browser-level mouse and keyboard events with real layout and hit-testing, not an OS-level mouse. From an empty data folder: New folder from the empty-tree offer, nested folder and connection through the context menu, inline rename, properties edits (inherited username and port show "from <folder>", local override, "Inherit" reset, Rust port error shown inline with the old value back, non-numeric port message), duplicate, delete dialog (Cancel has focus, Escape keeps everything, confirm removes the folder with its content, focus lands on a row). `connections.json` matched the screen after every step and no temp file was left. Drag and drop: drop inside a folder (highlight shown, new parent expanded, last child on disk), reorder before a sibling (insertion line shown), move a connection into another folder, folder onto its own child (nothing changes), Escape mid-drag, a click with a tiny wobble selects and never moves, a release outside the tree and a later hover and right-click move nothing. Restart: graceful close and relaunch gave a byte-identical file and the same tree, expanded folders and properties. (A forced kill can lose the not-yet-flushed expanded-folder state kept in `localStorage`; the tree data is unaffected.) Single instance: with the first window minimised, a second launch exited with code 0, left one process and brought the first window back to the foreground. Release build (`pnpm tauri build --no-bundle`): CSP served as `connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; default-src 'self'; …` without `unsafe-eval`, the tree loaded over IPC, an external fetch was blocked, and no console or CSP message appeared on load (the dev server does not apply the CSP, so the release build was used). Light and dark theme screenshots reviewed. OPEN: macOS and Linux (postponed by the owner, see "Open manual checks").

blocks.title: Open manual checks (owner)
blocks.text:
Postponed by the owner on 2026-11-15 until a macOS and a Linux machine are at hand; everything else in M0 to M2 that can be checked on Windows has been. Do not tick these off without running them, and add the result as evidence on the milestone's criterion.

**Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, WebKitGTK 4.1; Wayland on GNOME or KDE is the owner's setup):**

- M0: `pnpm tauri dev` opens the empty window; `pnpm tauri build` produces a binary that starts.
- M1: both themes render correctly (no missing CSS features), the bundled fonts load, the window follows the system dark/light setting.
- M2: `FERNJO_DATA_DIR=<scratch dir> pnpm tauri dev`, create nested folders and connections, drag them (drop inside, reorder, move into another folder, Escape mid-drag, release outside the tree), edit the properties panel, restart and compare. The data folder default is `~/.config/fernjo`.
- M2: generate `cargo run -p fernjo-core --example generate_tree -- <dir> 500`, start with `FERNJO_DATA_DIR=<dir>` and judge the filter lag; 23 tree rows visible at 1280×800 with a connection selected and the properties panel open.
- M2: start a second instance while the first is minimised and see whether the first window comes to the front (Wayland may refuse to raise a window; if so, note the behaviour and decide whether it needs a different approach).
- M2: the web inspector shows no CSP warning in the packaged build (`pnpm tauri build`), and the tree loads (IPC works under `connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost`).

**macOS:**

- The same M0 to M2 checks as above on a current macOS (WKWebView). The data folder default is `~/Library/Application Support/fernjo`.
- Pointer drag and drop and the context menu with a trackpad and with a mouse (right-click and Ctrl-click).

**What was checked on Windows and how:** the real app was driven through the WebView's DevTools protocol (see `CLAUDE.md`, section "Project-specific"), so layout, pointer events, console output and the served CSP are real, but no OS-level mouse or physical trackpad was involved; the feel of dragging with a physical device is the one thing a person still has to judge on any platform.
